threads.body: [Testing] This setup-only trace-ID variant still inherits `collectMetadata=true` from `withType<Test>()`. Removing its label and collection-script entry does not exclude it when the task is run in a metadata-enabled task graph; its spans would be merged into `when: default`. Explicitly disable metadata collection for this regression task while keeping it in `check`.

The stated Servlet/Tomcat cleanup is incomplete for the adjacent Tomcat 10 collection entries. `tomcat-10.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:30-32` still enables request-parameter capture for every test task, while lines 314-315 still collect the baseline and setup-only trace-ID variant. As a result, Tomcat 10 continues classifying captured request-parameter telemetry as default (and under the trace-ID label). Apply the same dedicated capture variant/default-off expectation there and stop collecting its trace-ID-only task.

replies.body:
Addressed in bae326392c0156a39ce54f96503ebf4f0d37e2d2.

Removed Tomcat 10's shared request-parameter flag, added testRequestParameterCapture with the existing test-* selection and matching metadataConfig, and wired it into check and instrumentations.sh. TomcatHandlerTest now exercises capture both enabled and disabled using the existing shared HTTP test expectation. The username-only variant no longer enables or labels parameter capture. The trace-ID variant retains behavioral coverage but has no metadataConfig, overrides collection to false, and is excluded from the collection script. Generated telemetry contained request-parameter attributes only under the dedicated capture label, never under default or the username label.

threads.body: [Testing] `testExperimental` is still wired into `check` while inheriting `collectMetadata=true` from `withType<Test>().configureEach`. Because the trace-ID request attribute is only used by the fixture and does not change emitted telemetry, a metadata-enabled `check` will collect this full suite without a label and merge it into `when: default`. Explicitly disable collection for this excluded variant rather than only removing `metadataConfig`.

replies.body:
Addressed in d7e0e5d791957963dd776cafc78129dd79c7447e.

Removing metadataConfig did not exclude testExperimental: AgentTestRunner still collected its telemetry when collectMetadata was true, and MetaDataCollector labeled unlabeled output default. Commit 1 overrides the inherited setting with systemProperty("collectMetadata", false) in both affected variants. Both complete module checks passed with collection enabled; forced reruns of both trace-ID suites passed without creating or modifying any telemetry files.
